text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The landform and compass are in
harmony...
Now's the time!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Go, White Tiger, Guardian of the West!
With
your special ability—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh ho ho, not so fast!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah! Ahhh?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Your affinity with the White Tiger's
attributes
wasn't quite there, was it? It
looks like I win
again.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Agh! Another loss!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm passing by the cafeteria,
I see
Copano Rickey and Wonder Acute
playing a card
game that's currently very
popular.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You draw a card, summon characters,
and then
make them fight in turns...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. Heh... I don't play this game
that
often, so it's not like I'm all that
experienced.
choice_data_list: Could it be you're not good at games?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And even with the landform and
compass aligned,
I just don't have the
skills I need to make the
most of my
plays.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yet you still agreed to play with me.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Because it looks so fun! I wanted to join
in with
everyone else too!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, ho ho. That's so like you, Rickey.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you'll figure it out after you've
played a
few times. Do call me again
whenever you'd like
to play something.
I'll gladly join you for anything
that's not
loud or flashy. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I come back to my office to find Copano
Rickey
perusing some of the cards from
before...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Mmm... Learning the rules is hard
enough,
but now I have to learn about
all these
characters, too...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the offer! I think I'd prefer to
try and
figure it out by myself, though,
y'know?
choice_data_list: Want me to join in your practice?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Losing all the time is so frustrating, and I
want to
actually enjoy playing! I'm going
to do my best to
get this down!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...It really is hard, though!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Yeah, that's a good strategy! Shall
we get
some tea and sweets ready?
That's what Acute
would do...
choice_data_list: Let's take breaks along the way and keep at it steadily!
How about memorizing it by associating it with something familiar?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Speaking of Acute...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Your affinity with the White Tiger's
attributes
wasn't quite there, was it? It
looks like I win
again.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Something I know... For me, that'd
definitely be
feng shui...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But how can I make that connection? I
know some
of the characters are related
to feng shui...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Your affinity with the White Tiger's
attributes
wasn't quite there, was it? It
looks like I win
again.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: She did say... "attributes"...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I was focusing on attack power and HP
the whole
time, but what about these
fire and leaf icons...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh! Ohhh!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Well, goodness me. That was like
playing
against a different opponent
altogether...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yayyy! I finally won!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After memorizing the cards with
blistering speed,
Copano Rickey goes on
to get her revenge!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
When Acute mentioned attributes, I
realized that
it's basically just an
elemental rock-paper-scissors
game!
choice_data_list: What on earth is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oho?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Water weakens fire qi, fire weakens
metal qi...
And you know how the rest
goes!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
When I realized the setup was similar to
how the
feng shui elements interact, it
all fell into place!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
After all, no one knows the ins and outs
of feng
shui better than me! I'll never
lose this game
again!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, did I drop you a helping hint by
accident
earlier on?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: But I'm not surprised you figured it all out. You're such a good girl, Rickey. And very clever. Here you go—have some sweeties.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't help wondering if maybe Copano
Rickey
can find a way to do anything as
long as she can
connect it to feng shui
somehow.
